question: Pin node #115's SystemClockWrapper vtable installers: the exact roles of the five installer routines (0x5fd0090, 0x6029110, 0x6029230, 0x6029500, 0x6029620), the shared record-append and shared_ptr-release helpers they call, and the three FactoryEntry entry thunks' mode-1 callers (0x5fcc5d0, 0x5fcc600, 0x5fcc630).

installers.name: SystemClockWrapper ctor C1
installers.role: installs the wrapper vtable 0x64cdd88, zeroes +0x08..+0x18, copies the wrapped-clock shared_ptr into +0x20/+0x28 with a use-count bump, and appends record {"", this+0x20, 0x6504b80} via 0x6099ce0 at 0x5fd0124

installers.name: EmulatedSystemClock D2 (slot 0)
installers.role: releases the +0x28 shared_ptr via 0x5d35070, installs the base vtable 0x64d3420+0x10, and destroys the +0x08 options vector (string-dispose each 0x30-byte record, then free the buffer)

installers.name: SystemClockWrapper D2
installers.role: byte-identical to the Emulated D2: releases +0x28, installs the base vtable, destroys the +0x08 vector

installers.name: SystemClockWrapper D0
installers.role: deleting destructor: the D2 body plus operator delete 0x30. Completely unreferenced: no direct caller, no qword hits, no RELATIVE slot. This explains why the wrapper vtable slots 0 and 1 are null

installers.name: EmulatedSystemClock D0 (slot 1)
installers.role: deleting destructor: the D2 body plus operator delete 0x50

append.role: appends one 0x30-byte {std::string, qword, qword} record to the vector at owner+0x08..+0x18; SSO copy for len<=15, _M_create for longer, grows via 0x6099790 at capacity

grow.role: doubles the options-vector capacity (0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaab divide-by-48, max check against 0x2aaaaaaaaaaaaaa, overflow allocation 0x7fffffffffffffe0), move-constructs the records (SSO strings copied inline, heap strings moved with the source nulled), frees the old buffer

emu_ctor.role: EmulatedSystemClock ctor C1: calls the wrapper ctor, installs the emulated vtable 0x64d1650, reads the wrapped clock's slot-24 GetCurrentTime (rdi=rsp+0x20 out, rsi=wrapped, rdx=rsp+0x18 value_out; rsp+0x18 preloaded with constant 0x4fb647d0), stores the value at +0x30, duplicates the mode byte at +0x48/+0x49, zeroes +0x38/+0x40, and appends two records via 0x6099ce0

last_use_helper.role: shared_ptr last-use helper: control-block slot 0x10 dispose, weak-count decrement at +0x0c (lock xadd iff the byte at 0x64ed290 is 0), old weak count 1 tail-jumps to slot 0x18 destroy. Shared libstdc++ machinery: 654 direct calls and 36 tail jumps binary-wide

landing_pad.role: _M_dispose temp string (r12 = rsp+0x30), calls the wrapper D2, checks the stack canary, _Unwind_Resume. Jumped to from 0x60294d8 in the emulated ctor

manager_ops.signature: manager(dest rdi, src rsi, op edx)

op_1.note: binary-wide scan found no real manager invocation with op 1; the single edx=1 candidate at 0x2320375 is a GOT call at 0x64e00a0, not a manager call

op_3.effect: destroy the functor (no-op for a plain function pointer)

manager_ops.answer: No caller passes a mode-1 pointer through the thunks: the op-0/op-1 arms are never invoked; only ops 2 and 3 are exercised. Mode 1 reaches the emulated clock through the factory 0x60297a0, not through a thunk.

reg_sysclocks.role: RegisterBuiltinSystemClocks: builds the {manager=thunk1, invoker=0x5fcd5b0} function named MockEnv and the {manager=thunk2, invoker=0x5fcf450} function named CompositeEnv, inserts each via 0x5fd24c0 (0x5fd2848, 0x5fd28c3), destroys the temps with op 3, then calls 0x61f8700

default_init.role: SystemClock default initializer: builds the {manager=thunk3, invoker=0x5fcd550} function named TimeEmulatedSystemClock and inserts it inline (same shape as insert: new 0x30 function node, new 0x70 entry, op-2 clone, mutex lock, 0x5fd1da0 at 0x5fd22b4, op-3 destroy at 0x5fd22fe, 0x61f8700 at 0x5fd2310)
default_init.node_vtable_note: the 0x30-byte function node's vtable pointer is 0x64cde88 (node vtable slot 2, 0x5fcc7e0); that slot's role is an open unknown

insert.role: registry insert: new(0x30) function node (vtable 0x64cde68), op-2 clone of the caller's function, new(0x70) entry (vtable 0x64d8ed0), name string copied via 0x5fcd6f0, mutex lock, calls 0x5fd1da0 under the lock, frees the temp node on failure and destroys the entry on the duplicate path

node_dtor.role: registry node D2: installs the node base vtable 0x64cde68, destroys the stored function via manager op 3 (0x5fcc72b), then tail-jumps to the entry's D0 (slot 1 of the entry object at node+0x08)

invokers.name: TimeEmulatedSystemClock invoker
invokers.role: new(0x50) + Emulated C1(mode 0, wrap the PosixClock); replaces the *(*rdx) cell, D0-deletes the old clock if non-null

invokers.name: MockEnv invoker
invokers.role: holder accessor 0x5fe2860, then the factory 0x60297a0 (mode-1 emulated clock), stores the holder in the cell

invokers.name: CompositeEnv invoker
invokers.role: new(0x60), holder accessor 0x5fe2860, 0x5fcf430, 0x5fcf390, builder 0x5fd7360 (FDE 0x5fd7360..0x5fd7466; calls append 3x)

factory.role: make_shared<EmulatedSystemClock>: new(0x60), in-place control block (vtable 0x64d1c38, counts 0x100000001 from 0x459b20), Emulated C1(mode 1, wrapped = 0x5fcf430(holder)), installs the shared_ptr into the holder via 0x6028d80

accessor.role: 9 bytes: returns arg+0x38 (the holder's wrapped-clock shared_ptr slot)

holder.role: returns the holder at 0x6504cc0 (guard 0x6504ca8); first call initializes from the PosixClock accessor 0x5fe2680 and builds .bss state 0x6504d08..0x6504d78 with pthread_mutex_init. Full body is a separate work item; cited here by contract

third field of the emulated ctor's first record; also lea'd at 0x6029e50 inside the factory; .bss
